data.reasoning: This is generic UI chrome (a minus box used for collapsing trees, removing items, or showing an indeterminate checkbox state) rather than a real-world task subject. In a to-do app, placing a boxed minus next to a task looks like a second, skipped/indeterminate checkbox and confuses the user.
